Data Analyst

About the company
Tailspin Outdoor Retail sells camping gear online and in 30 stores.

Responsibilities
- Build dashboards in Tableau or Power BI for business stakeholders.
- Analyze sales data to identify trends and present findings.

Requirements
- Strong SQL skills.
- Experience with Excel and data visualization.
- Excellent stakeholder communication.
- Rockstar mindset and ability to wear many hats.
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field.

Preferred
- Experience with Python and pandas.
- A/B testing experience.

Benefits
- Employee discount and paid volunteer days.
